review.posthog_relevance: Adds OAuth provisioning checks and access confirmation status to the Connected Apps API and frontend, alongside a listener to handle 404 responses on app revocation. This could help users identify OAuth apps requiring access confirmation and prevent stale UI state after access lapses.

observations.behavior: Adds a new field `requires_access_confirmation` to the OAuth connected apps API response and the frontend connected apps list.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if an OAuth application is associated with an organization provisioning record, and if so, marks it as requiring access confirmation. This could help users identify and manage OAuth apps that set up their organization without explicit verification.

observations.behavior: Adds a listener to reload the connected apps list when a revoke request returns a 404, indicating the app access already lapsed.
observations.posthog_connection: Handles the case where a user revokes an OAuth app, but the backend returns a 404 because the access already lapsed. This could help prevent stale UI state and improve user experience.
